content:
Ludwig Güterbock (1880–1944) was a German Assyriologist and Hittitologist known for his contributions to the study of ancient Near Eastern languages and history. He made significant advances in deciphering and understanding Hittite texts and was a prominent scholar in the early 20th century. His work helped illuminate aspects of Hittite civilization, language, and their connections with other ancient cultures.
